behavior.child_before_parent: for each node, the whole +0x18 child list is destroyed before the node itself is disposed
behavior.dispose_order: per node: string 2 at +0x48 first, then string 1 at +0x28, then the node itself sized-deleted with size 0x68
behavior.general: destroy a sibling list of 0x68-byte nodes: for each node, destroy its +0x18 child list, dispose the node, then advance via its +0x10 sibling; a null head frees nothing
behavior.node_delete_size: every node is sized-deleted with size 0x68 via _ZdlPvm@plt 0x5660440 (GOT 0x5778f48)
behavior.null_head: a null entry pointer returns immediately (ret at 0x514d005) and frees nothing
behavior.recursion: the +0x18 descent is unrolled six links deep in the bytes and recurses through the self-call at 0x514cd9c for deeper levels; the observable order is the plain destroy_list recursion
behavior.sibling_order: siblings are destroyed in +0x10 order, each after its own child list
behavior.string_heap: a heap string buffer is sized-deleted with size capacity + 1 (string 2 via _M_dispose@plt 0x5660470, GOT 0x5778f60; string 1 via the same rule inlined in most blocks)
behavior.string_sso: an SSO string (pointer equal to the node's own +0x38 for string 1, or +0x58 for string 2) deletes no buffer
behavior.wrapper_effect: the 0x514d010 wrapper destroys the list at [container+0x10] by calling 0x514cd00 on each node's +0x18 child list and disposing the node itself, which is exactly destroy_list([container+0x10])
